summary: All 14 lessons carry findings. The factual layer is largely sound - 21 factual corrections, of which two are HIGH (Attlee did not attend Yalta; East German troops did not enter Czechoslovakia in 1968). The exam layer was the real problem: 16 of 84 practice questions were set in forms this paper does not use ('Source-Based Essay', '8-mark Source Evaluation'), 26 four-mark questions asked for identification instead of a supported inference with contextual knowledge, eleven exam tips carried invented examiner claims (three of them telling students not to use contextual knowledge on a question that requires it), and 36 composed sources carried invented archive provenances. Lesson 14 also taught and examined material from 1975-81, outside the 1945-1972 option. 160 edits.
